Add it here as a product only after an FDA approval letter is posted.

This is the date FDA required the change, not the date the labels changed: label supplements adding the warning were approved on 2024-04-12 for Kymriah, Yescarta and Tecartus (letters read), and FDA's public statement that the warning is required is dated 2024-04-18.
class_and_coding_events.source_title: FDA 2024 Safety and Availability Communications (lists the January 2024 notification letters and the April 18, 2024 statement)
